digest.component_or_area: Rebar LLM Agent run and structured output handling
propositions: Successful retries must report aggregate whole-run usage once in memory, telemetry, and exactly one JSONL row without per-attempt rows or rejected-output subtraction
Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original StructuredOutputError object found by traversing the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain through ToolRetryError and ModelRetry
Repeated-truncation/concision exhaustion must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError when no Rebar object exists on the cause chain (concision_guard raises bare ModelRetry with no __cause__)
Terminal failure must preserve consumed requests and tokens in diagnostics without inventing usage values for calls that reported none
Parse-failure artifacts must capture and store only the complete final provider response when enabled, never partial or intermediate responses from the retry wire
Existing pricing and usage schema must remain byte-compatible with no new competing request-budget fields like candidate_requests
